author: TheMasterClock
body:
Hey.

I just got banned on the Avicus TeamSpeak server for Suicide Encourgement. I did fully know that I said it in a Cursing Allowed channel and knew that it wasn't allowed. I deeply apologize to Peachy and Zac, I learned my lesson. Have a great day!

Regards,
TheMasterClock
